AY Product Updates: New Features and Improvements

Smarter Tools, Better Insights, and Optimized Performance!

We are excited to share the latest updates to our platform! Over the past six months, we’ve focused on enhancing functionality, boosting performance, and providing tools to make your monetization more efficient.

👇🏻 Below, you’ll find a summary of these updates and how they benefit you.

🚀 New Features 

Prebid Server-Side

  • Dynamic Flooring
    Unique machine learning models tailored to your historical data maximize your revenue by setting the optimal price floor.

Yield Manager

  • User Deployment Notifications
    Stay informed about deployment changes with automated email summaries, ensuring better transparency and traceability.
  • Placements Under Ad Units
    Simplify management by organizing placements under corresponding Ad Units for improved usability.

  • Global Variables
    Save time and reduce errors by defining variables across all entities in your organization for consistent configuration.

  • Refresh by Line Item Type
    Gain greater control by disabling refresh for specific line item types like Sponsorship, ensuring compliance with specific advertiser needs.
  • Automatic Prebid Building
    Build and upload Prebid code directly through the Yield Manager Dashboard, eliminating manual building and uploading.

Yield Optimizer - Traffic Shaping

  • Automated Floor Price Optimization
    Automatically apply the best-performing floor prices with server-side models that are updated hourly, ensuring maximum revenue potential for your traffic.
  • GAM Flooring Support
    Extend holistic flooring to include In-App inventory, enabling consistent optimization across all inventory types.

Yield Optimizer - Dynamic Flooring

  • Server-Side Flooring
    Manage floor prices on the server side using large  ML models with automatic optimization to improve auction revenue.

Yield Intelligence - Analytics

  • Quick Share
    Save time with one-click sharing of reports with other users in your organization, speeding up analysis and decision-making.
  • Custom API Key Generation
    Gain more control over your data with personal access tokens, improving visibility and security for your  API use.
  • Export to Google Sheets
    Seamlessly export report data into Google Sheets for further analysis or sharing with your team.

🔧 Improvements 

Yield Optimizer - Dynamic Flooring

  • Client-Side Refactor
    Enjoy a more reliable and maintainable flooring system that improves performance across all client-side operations.
  • Dynamic Segmentation Optimization
    Continuously optimize traffic adjustments through dynamic segmentation for better results.

Prebid Server-Side

  • Infrastructure Upgrades
    Handle traffic spikes and bad bidders more effectively, ensuring higher platform reliability and stability.
  • Enhanced Video Integrations
    Deliver a smoother video ad experience with gradual support rollout for In-App integrations.
  • Auction Optimization
    Improved handling of bad bidders to reduce their negative impact on auction performance, ensuring better results.

Yield Manager

  • Customized Editor Enhancements
    Save time and reduce errors with syntax checking and code formatting built into the editor.
  • Quick-Analytics by Deployment Version
    Quick access to reports tied to specific deployments for granular insights and faster troubleshooting.
  • Preview Enhancements
    Pin and quickly access recently viewed preview URLs, saving time during testing and debugging.

Data Integrations 

  • Outbrain & Taboola Improvements
    Revenue attribution is now based on clicks instead of impressions (optionally), offering more accurate and actionable insights.
  • Pinterest DSP Integration
    Track campaign spend with new reporting capabilities, providing a more comprehensive view of your ad performance.

🙌 What’s Next?

We hope these updates improve your workflow, enhance your experience, and deliver measurable and better results. 

For more details or to explore how these updates can directly benefit your operations, feel free to contact your account manager or reach out to us at: https://www.assertiveyield.com/help-center/ay-support/
